A.name: Collapsed Effect/Success Model
A.frozen: A selected/admitted capability that executes successfully is treated as the realized Outcome; process/provider/domain success collapse into one effect/result, causal credit is implicit, consumption is associated with successful use, and only successful effects normally update Knowledge.

B.name: Action–Effect Ledger
B.frozen: Action and Effect are distinct. An Action is an admitted/committed attempt and owner-native Effect history may be succeeded, failed or unknown. Domain Outcome remains folded into Effect/result semantics, Attribution is implicit or optional metadata, and Knowledge is derived from retained Action/Effect history without a separate semantic promotion boundary.

C.name: Full Linear Conversion Chain
C.frozen: One selected Option/feasible assignment advances through a directional chain: Action -> resource consumption -> Effect -> Outcome -> Attribution -> Knowledge. The stages are semantically distinct and may be unavailable/negative, but the episode remains fundamentally linear: Outcome is downstream of Action/Effect, Attribution is downstream of Outcome, and Knowledge is downstream of Outcome/Attribution.

D.name: Action/Effect Events + Outcome/Attribution Projections
D.frozen: Selection/Decision may commit an Action: an identity-bound admitted attempt to cause or obtain a transition. Owner-native Effect events/claims record direct physical or semantic consequences and may be success, failure, no-effect or unknown. Outcome is a domain-owned evaluation projection over one or many Effects, exogenous facts, objective/observer/horizon and comparison context; it may be positive, negative, neutral or unavailable. Attribution is a separate causal/credit claim with explicit evidence and uncertainty and may remain unavailable even when Outcome is known. Knowledge is an externally/domain-promoted reusable claim that can arise from successful, failed, invalid or uncertain episodes when evidence changes future prediction/selection. Consumption is resource-family-specific Event/quantity accounting during the attempt/effect window, not a universal stage. Relations are many-to-many rather than one mandatory lifecycle.

relationLedger.reason: A decision can exist without external dispatch; changing decision quality and executing it are separate truths.

relationLedger.placement: identity-bound admitted/committed attempt to cause or obtain transition
relationLedger.reason: Deleting Action erases the difference between attempted/admitted work and what physically or semantically happened.
Physical/semantic consequence history remains true independently from higher-domain value.

relationLedger.placement: domain-owned evaluation projection over effects + exogenous context + objective/observer/horizon/comparison
relationLedger.reason: Execution truth cannot answer whether capital, player experience, creative work, science or retained Human capability improved.
The same effects can evaluate differently under inflation benchmark, player perception, audience, or delayed retention horizon.

relationLedger.placement: separate causal/credit Claim with evidence and uncertainty
relationLedger.reason: Observed Outcome does not automatically identify which action/resource/agent/environment caused it.

relationLedger.placement: owner/domain-promoted reusable Claim that changes future prediction/selection
relationLedger.reason: Evidence or a completion candidate does not automatically deserve durable reusable Knowledge; failures/invalid trials may still teach.

relationLedger.placement: resource-family-specific Event/quantity relation during Action/Effect window
relationLedger.reason: Tokens, attention or single-use authority may be consumed even when target Effect/Outcome fails; non-rival knowledge may be reused without depletion.

relationLedger.placement: owner-native unresolved/unknown effect state or claim
relationLedger.reason: Unknown is not success/failure and must block unsafe inference/retry while preserving the Action identity.

relationLedger.placement: many-to-many relation among Actions, Effects and Outcomes
relationLedger.reason: One action can create several effects; one long-horizon outcome can aggregate many effects; some effects/outcomes are exogenous.
Empty/missing observations cannot be promoted to absence or outcome truth; source/domain owners retain evidence semantics.

relationLedger.placement: owner/domain decision to retain consequential Knowledge/Outcome/Attribution evidence
relationLedger.reason: Technical success, critique or candidate completion should not automatically become selected asset, scientific conclusion or reusable procedure.

deletionTests.mutation: delete Action as distinct from Effect
deletionTests.why: Cannot distinguish admitted attempt/dispatch from succeeded, failed, unknown or absent consequences.

deletionTests.mutation: delete Effect as distinct from Outcome
deletionTests.why: Physical/semantic execution truth would be misused as domain-value truth.
The system loses the actual consumer/domain objective and can optimize substrate success instead.
Outcome observation alone cannot assign causal credit or blame to Action, Resource, Agent or environment.
Raw failure/completion evidence would automatically become durable reusable knowledge without semantic evaluation.

deletionTests.mutation: force Outcome to be downstream of an Agent Action
deletionTests.why: Capital and other domain outcomes can change through exogenous effects without an Agent action lineage.

deletionTests.mutation: force one Action -> one Effect -> one Outcome
deletionTests.why: Multiplicity and nested outcomes are real; exact one-to-one lineage is not universal.

deletionTests.mutation: force Knowledge to require resolved positive Outcome + Attribution
deletionTests.why: Invalid/failed/uncertain episodes can produce methodological or recovery knowledge.

deletionTests.mutation: make Consumption a universal stage between Action and Effect
deletionTests.why: Consumption is resource-family accounting; it may occur before failure, be partial, renewable, rival, or non-rival.

deletionTests.mutation: collapse Outcome into one scalar useful/value score
deletionTests.why: Outcome can be multidimensional, horizon-dependent and distributional; current scalar prior loses failure structure.

deletionTests.mutation: allow Effect owner/receipt to assert higher-domain Outcome
deletionTests.why: Runtime/provider/render receipts do not own Finance/Game/Studio/Security/Human semantic value.

deletionTests.mutation: automatically persist every effect/review/completion as Knowledge
deletionTests.why: Durable promotion requires consequential semantic evaluation; most critique/results remain local evidence.

freshProjectionTests.case: One admitted API action writes a provider object, emits a bill, and updates an audit log; one Action has several distinct Effects with different owners.
A monthly capital Outcome is evaluated over hundreds of trades, funding bills, mark-to-market changes and owner flows rather than one Action.
A venue funding payment changes capital while the Agent takes no action; Outcome observation exists without Action lineage.
An order is correctly filled and reconciled but the position subsequently loses money; Effect succeeds while domain Outcome is negative.
An external request becomes outcome-unknown, later reconciliation resolves the Effect, while the earlier ambiguity teaches a recovery rule before any value Outcome is known.
A rate-limit token, Human attention block or single-use Activation is consumed by an attempt that fails before its intended Effect.
A portfolio Outcome is positive and fully measured but Agent contribution remains unavailable because no evidence-backed counterfactual exists.
An invalid experiment answers none of the target scientific question but exposes a measurement/provenance flaw that is promoted into future method Knowledge.

provisionalSurvivor.name: Action/Effect Events + Outcome/Attribution Projections
provisionalSurvivor.compression: Conversion is not one success pipeline. Selection may commit an Action; owner-native Effect events/claims preserve what directly happened or remains unknown; domain-owned Outcome projections evaluate consequences under objective/observer/horizon/context; Attribution is a separate causal claim; Knowledge requires semantic promotion and may arise from successful, failed, invalid or uncertain evidence. Consumption is family-specific accounting parallel to the attempt/effect window. Relations are many-to-many and exogenous effects/outcomes are allowed.
